name: NoUiSlider
description: Adds a noUiSlider range/steps slider widget to Better Exposed Filters for multi-value select exposed filters in Views.
project_description:
This is a noUiSlider integration for Drupal. It provides a noUiSlider

element for select list and entity reference fields.

 Kudos to nikathone for his initial work on this project.

 Features 
 The module convert a view exposed multi select filter to NoUiSlider widget for better UI experience.

 Post-Installation 
 When enabled, the module will add a new option (NoUiSlider) to Better Exposed Filter settings

inside the View.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires the following modules:

 Better Exposed Filters 

 And the following library:

 noUiSlider 

 Back to top
